description: This file contains unit tests for the SecurityGroup class in SuiteCRM, covering constructor validation, method correctness, security module retrieval, group membership functions, and database interactions.

classes.name: SecurityGroupTest
classes.description: Unit test class for SecurityGroup model, validating constructor, security group methods, and database interactions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, creates a current user bean.

methods.name: testSecurityGroup
methods.description: Verifies the correct instantiation of SecurityGroup object and its properties.

methods.name: testgetGroupWhere
methods.description: Tests correctness of the SQL WHERE clause generated for security group filtering.

methods.name: testgetGroupUsersWhere
methods.description: Tests the correctness of the SQL WHERE clause for security group user filtering.

methods.name: testgetGroupJoin
methods.description: Validates the SQL JOIN clause for security groups with different modules.

methods.name: testgetGroupUsersJoin
methods.description: Checks the correctness of the JOIN clause for retrieving users in a security group.

methods.name: testgroupHasAccess
methods.description: Tests the static method for checking if a group has access based on parameters.

methods.name: testinherit
methods.description: Validates inheritance of security group permissions for an account without exceptions.

methods.name: testassign_default_groups
methods.description: Tests assigning default groups to an account.

methods.name: testinherit_creator
methods.description: Checks inheritance of creator-based security groups.

methods.name: testinherit_assigned
methods.description: Verifies inheritance for assigned user groups.

methods.name: testinherit_parent
methods.description: Tests inheritance from a parent account.

methods.name: testinherit_parentQuery
methods.description: Validates the query for inheriting parent security information.

methods.name: testinheritOne
methods.description: Tests static inheritance method returning false for specific conditions.

methods.name: testgetMembershipCount
methods.description: Checks that the member count for a security group returns 0.

methods.name: testSaveAndRetrieveAndRemoveDefaultGroups
methods.description: Full cycle test: creates a default group, verifies retrieval, and cleanup.

methods.name: testgetSecurityModules
methods.description: Ensures the retrieved security modules include expected entries.

methods.name: testgetLinkName
methods.description: Tests the link name mapping between module and related entity.

methods.name: testaddGroupToRecord
methods.description: Verifies adding a security group to a specified record.

methods.name: testremoveGroupFromRecord
methods.description: Verifies removal of a security group from a record.

methods.name: testgetUserSecurityGroups
methods.description: Ensures retrieval of security groups for a user returns an array.

methods.name: testgetAllSecurityGroups
methods.description: Checks retrieving all security groups.

methods.name: testgetMembers
methods.description: Verifies fetching members of a security group.

methods.name: testgetPrimaryGroupID
methods.description: Checks that primary group ID retrieval returns null.
